sentences.en: It had been raining for days.
sentences.zh: 它有是雨为了一天。

sentences.en: "All this rain," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 全部这个雨， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I wish it would stop."
sentences.zh: 我希望它会停。

sentences.en: "I'm taking Floppy for a walk," said Mum.
sentences.zh: Floppy 为了一个走， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "Who wants to come?"
sentences.zh: 谁想要到来？

sentences.en: Biff and Chip looked at her.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 看在她。

sentences.en: "Not us!" They said.
sentences.zh: 不！ 不我们！ 他们说。

sentences.en: "It's raining!"
sentences.zh: 它是雨！

sentences.en: In the end, Biff said she would go with Mum.
sentences.zh: 在……里这末尾， Biff 说她会去和……一起妈妈。

sentences.en: They went into the park.
sentences.zh: 他们去进入这公园。

sentences.en: It was not much fun in the rain.
sentences.zh: 它是不许多乐趣在……里这雨。

sentences.en: "Look at Floppy," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 看在 Floppy， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "He can't help getting muddy.
sentences.zh: 他不能帮助得到泥泞的。

sentences.en: The ground is so wet and squelchy."
sentences.zh: 这地面是所以湿的和松软的。

sentences.en: Biff and Mum walked across the park.
sentences.zh: Biff 和妈妈走穿过这公园。

sentences.en: They wanted to cross the little bridge, but the stream had flooded.
sentences.zh: 他们想要到叉形这小的桥梁， 但是这溪流有洪水。

sentences.en: "I've never seen it this high," Said Mum.
sentences.zh: T've 从不看见它这个高的， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: Biff was excited.
sentences.zh: Biff 是兴奋的。

sentences.en: "Oh look!" She said.
sentences.zh: 哦看！ 她说。

sentences.en: "The bridge is under water."
sentences.zh: 这桥梁是在……下方水。

sentences.en: Biff began to wade across the bridge, but Mum called her back.
sentences.zh: Biff 开始到趟水穿过这桥梁， 但是妈妈叫她回来。

sentences.en: "It's not a good idea," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 它是不一个好的主意， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "The stream is flowing really fast and you can't see the edge of it.
sentences.zh: 这溪流是流畅的真的快的和你不能看见这边缘的它。

sentences.en: What if you slipped in?" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么如果你滑倒在……里？ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "If it goes on raining, the water will flood across the park," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 如果它去在……上雨， 这水将洪水穿过这公园， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Mum looked thoughtful.
sentences.zh: 妈妈看沉思的。

sentences.en: "I hope the rain stops," she said.
sentences.zh: 我希望这雨停， 她说。

sentences.en: "We don't want the flood to get as far as our house."
sentences.zh: 我们不想要这洪水到得到像远像我们的房子。

sentences.en: The next morning, when Biff and Chip were at school, it was still raining.
sentences.zh: 这下一个早晨， 当……时 Biff 和 Chip 是在学校， 它是仍然雨。

sentences.en: The children couldn't go out to play.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们不能去出到玩。

sentences.en: "Another wet playtime," sighed Chip.
sentences.zh: 另一个湿的游戏时间， 叹气 Chip。

sentences.en: "I wish it would stop raining." "So do I," sighed Mrs May, too.
sentences.zh: 我希望它会停雨。 不做它。

sentences.en: In the afternoon it stopped raining.
sentences.zh: 在……里这下午它停雨。

sentences.en: "Hooray!
Now we can play football," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 现在我们能玩足球运动， 说 Wilf。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: But there were big puddles on the field.
sentences.zh: 但是那里是大的水洼在……上这田地。

sentences.en: "I'm sorry," said Mrs May.
sentences.zh: 我是对不起， 说这男人。

sentences.en: "We can't play football today.
sentences.zh: 我们不能玩足球运动在今天。

sentences.en: The ground is too wet."
sentences.zh: 这地面是也湿的。

sentences.en: That evening,.
sentences.zh: 那是使人十分惊奇的。

sentences.en: That evening Biff, Chip and Kipper were watching television.
sentences.zh: 那个晚上 Biff， Chip 和 Kipper 是手表电视。

sentences.en: The weather forecast came on.
sentences.zh: 这天气天气预报来在……上。

sentences.en: Some bad storms were coming, with a lot more rain.
sentences.zh: 一些坏的暴风雨是来， 和……一起一个许多更多雨。

sentences.en: "Not more rain!" Sighed Chip.
sentences.zh: 不更多雨！ 叹气 Chip。 我得到它， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The storm came in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 这暴风雨来在……里这中间的这夜晚。

sentences.en: The rain beat on the roof of the house and it lashed against the windows.
sentences.zh: 这雨击打在……上这屋顶的这房子和它睫毛紧靠着这窗户。

sentences.en: It was so loud that Biff and Chip couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 它是所以大声的那个 Biff 和 Chip 不能睡觉。

sentences.en: Mum brought them a hot drink.
sentences.zh: 妈妈带来他们一个热的喝。

sentences.en: "Poor Floppy," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "He hates this."
sentences.zh: 他帽子这个。

sentences.en: In the morning, Dad took Floppy for a walk.
sentences.zh: 在……里这早晨， 爸爸拿 Floppy 为了一个走。

sentences.en: Chip went with him.
sentences.zh: Chip 去和……一起他。

sentences.en: When they got to the park, Chip gasped.
sentences.zh: 当……时他们得到到这公园， Chip 喘气。

sentences.en: The park was flooded.
sentences.zh: 这公园是洪水。

sentences.en: It was like a giant lake.
sentences.zh: 它是喜欢一个巨人拉客。

sentences.en: Chip thought the floods were fun.
sentences.zh: Chip 想这洪水是乐趣。

sentences.en: Dad looked worried.
sentences.zh: 爸爸看发愁的。

sentences.en: "I don't like the look of this," he said.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢这看的这个， 他说。

sentences.en: "We don't want the water to get as far as our house."
sentences.zh: 我们不想要这水到得到像远像我们的房子。

sentences.en: Chip grinned at Dad.
sentences.zh: Chip 露齿而笑在爸爸。

sentences.en: "It couldn't go that far," he said.
sentences.zh: 它不能去那个远， 他说。

sentences.en: "Could it?"
sentences.zh: 能它？

sentences.en: But it didn't stop raining, and the floods grew worse.
sentences.zh: 但是它没有停雨， 和这洪水 grew 更坏的。

sentences.en: The water reached the edge of the park.
sentences.zh: 这水到达这边缘的这公园。

sentences.en: Then it began to creep up the road.
sentences.zh: 然后它开始到悄悄行进向上这路。

sentences.en: It came through the fence and flooded the end of the garden.
sentences.zh: 它来穿过这分册和洪水这末尾的这花园。

sentences.en: The road near Wilf and Wilma's house was flooded.
sentences.zh: 这路在……附近 Wilf 和 Wilma 房子是洪水。

sentences.en: The children watched the cars going through the flood.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们手表这汽车去穿过这洪水。

sentences.en: One car had broken down and was stuck in the middle.
sentences.zh: 一汽车有打破向下和是 stuck 在……里这中间。

sentences.en: That day,.
sentences.zh: 那是好的。

sentences.en: The school was closed.
sentences.zh: 那个一天， 这学校是关上。

sentences.en: The hall was flooded and there was no heating.
sentences.zh: 这门厅是洪水和那里是不暖气设备。

sentences.en: "What are we going to do all day?" Asked Wilf.
sentences.zh: 什么是我们去到做全部一天？ 问 Wilf。 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "I'm sorry," Said Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: 我是对不起， 说这男人。 Wilf， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "We can't open the school today."
sentences.zh: 我们不能打开这学校在今天。

sentences.en: When the children got home, they saw a lorry in the street.
sentences.zh: 当……时这孩子们得到家， 他们看见一个卡车在……里这街道。

sentences.en: It was loaded with sandbags.
sentences.zh: 它是装载和……一起沙袋。

sentences.en: People were taking the sandbags to their houses.
sentences.zh: 人们是拿这沙袋到他们的房子。

sentences.en: "We need you all to help," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 我们必须你全部到帮助， 说妈妈。 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip helped to carry the sandbags.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 帮助到搬运这沙袋。

sentences.en: They were very heavy.
sentences.zh: 他们是非常重的。

sentences.en: Dad put them in front of the doors.
sentences.zh: 爸爸放他们在……里前面的这门。

sentences.en: "I just hope the water doesn't come up this far," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚希望这水不来向上这个远， 说爸爸。 Kipper， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: Mum looked upset.
sentences.zh: 妈妈看使苦恼。

sentences.en: "The floods may get worse," she said.
sentences.zh: 这洪水梅得到更坏的， 她说。

sentences.en: "So there's only one thing to do."
sentences.zh: 所以有只有一东西到做。

sentences.en: She picked up a chair.
sentences.zh: 她挑选向上一个椅子。

sentences.en: "We'll have to take things upstairs," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 我们会有到拿东西在楼上， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 我们是， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: They all began to carry things upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他们全部开始到搬运东西在楼上。

sentences.en: It was hard work and Kipper began to get worried.
sentences.zh: 它是困难的工作和 Kipper 开始到得到发愁的。

sentences.en: "What will happen if the water floods into my bedroom?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 什么将发生如果这水洪水进入我的卧室？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "Don't worry," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 不担心， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "It won't."
sentences.zh: 它不会。

sentences.en: Some things were too big and heavy to carry upstairs.
sentences.zh: 一些东西是也大的和重的到搬运在楼上。

sentences.en: "What shall we do with the sofa?" Asked Dad.
sentences.zh: 什么将我们做和……一起这长沙发？ 问爸爸。

sentences.en: Mum had a good idea.
sentences.zh: 妈妈有一个好的主意。

sentences.en: She got a folding table.
sentences.zh: 她得到一个可折叠的桌子。

sentences.en: "We can put the sofa up on this," she said.
sentences.zh: 我们能放这长沙发向上在……上这个， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: It rained in the night.
sentences.zh: 它雨在……里这夜晚。

sentences.en: Dad couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 爸爸不能睡觉。

sentences.en: He was too worried about the flood.
sentences.zh: 他是也发愁的关于这洪水。

sentences.en: Then he heard the sound of water.
sentences.zh: 然后他听见这声音的水。

sentences.en: He went downstairs and looked.
sentences.zh: 他去在楼下和看。

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.zh: 哦不！

sentences.en: The flood water had come in.
sentences.zh: 这洪水水有来在……里。

sentences.en: Everyone woke up.
sentences.zh: 每个人醒来向上。

sentences.en: The lights didn't work, so Mum lit a lamp.
sentences.zh: 这轻的没有工作， 所以妈妈 lit 一个灯。

sentences.en: They all looked downstairs.
sentences.zh: 他们全部看在楼下。

sentences.en: The hall was full of water.
sentences.zh: 这门厅是满的的水。

sentences.en: "This is terrible," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 这个是可怕的， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Lots of houses must be flooded."
sentences.zh: 许多的房子必须是洪水。

sentences.en: The next day, Biff, Chip and Kipper looked out of the window.
sentences.zh: 这下一个一天， Biff， Chip 和 Kipper 看出的这窗户。

sentences.en: The whole street was flooded.
sentences.zh: 这全部的街道是洪水。

sentences.en: "I can't believe it," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我不能相信它， 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "It looks like a river." "It's amazing," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它看喜欢一个河。 那是使人十分惊奇的。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: A man paddled past in a canoe.
sentences.zh: 一个男人短桨过在……里一个独木舟。

sentences.en: It looked funny to see a canoe in the street.
sentences.zh: 它看有趣的到看见一个独木舟在……里这街道。

sentences.en: The man shouted up to them.
sentences.zh: 这男人喊向上到他们。

sentences.en: "Are you all right?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 是你全部正确的？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "Yes, thank you," Chip called back.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。 是谢谢你， Chip 叫回来。

sentences.en: "But we wish the flood would go away."
sentences.zh: 但是我们希望这洪水会去离开。

sentences.en: Some fire officers came to the street.
sentences.zh: 一些火军官来到这街道。

sentences.en: They wore big, long boots.
sentences.zh: 他们穿大的， 长的靴子。

sentences.en: "Can we take you to somewhere warm and dry?"
sentences.zh: 能我们拿你到在某处温暖的和干的？ 问一个火军官。

sentences.en: Asked a fire officer.
sentences.zh: 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "Yes, please," Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 是请， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "I don't think we can stay here."
sentences.zh: 我不想我们能停留这里。

sentences.en: The fire officers brought a dinghy to the front door.
sentences.zh: 这火军官带来一个小舢板到这前面门。

sentences.en: Everyone got in.
sentences.zh: 每个人得到在……里。

sentences.en: Dad carried Floppy.
sentences.zh: 爸爸搬运 Floppy。

sentences.en: "I never thought we'd sail up our street in a boat," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我从不想 we'd 帆向上我们的街道在……里一个船， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Wilf and Wilma were in their house.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Wilma 是在……里他们的房子。

sentences.en: They were looking out of the window.
sentences.zh: 他们是看出的这窗户。

sentences.en: Biff, Chip and Kipper waved at them.
sentences.zh: Biff， Chip 和 Kipper 波浪在他们。

sentences.en: "You can come and rescue us, next," called Wilma.
sentences.zh: 你能来和解救我们， 下一个， 叫 Wilma。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: A cat was stuck on a fence.
sentences.zh: 一个猫是 stuck 在……上一个分册。

sentences.en: The fire officer stopped the dinghy.
sentences.zh: 这火军官停这小舢板。

sentences.en: Dad rescued it and gave it to Mum.
sentences.zh: 爸爸解救它和给它到妈妈。

sentences.en: Floppy looked at the cat, but he didn't even bark.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看在这猫， 但是他没有竟然吠叫。

sentences.en: "He is being a good dog," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 他是正在一个好的狗， 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: They went to a hall in the town.
sentences.zh: 他们去到一个门厅在……里这城镇。

sentences.en: A lot of people were there.
sentences.zh: 一个许多的人们是那里。

sentences.en: Wilf and Wilma came in with their mum and dad.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Wilma 来在……里和……一起他们的妈妈和爸爸。

sentences.en: Biff showed Wilma the rescued cat.
sentences.zh: Biff 展示 Wilma 这解救猫。

sentences.en: "Poor little thing," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 贫穷的小的东西， 说 Wilma。 所以是我们， 说 Wilma。 哦不！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "We may have to stay here tonight," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们梅有到停留这里今夜， 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "We can't go back home to sleep." Kipper was upset.
sentences.zh: 我们不能去回来家到睡觉。 Kipper 是使苦恼。

sentences.en: There were too many people in the hall.
sentences.zh: 那里是也许多人们在……里这门厅。

sentences.en: He didn't want to sleep there.
sentences.zh: 他没有想要到睡觉那里。

sentences.en: "I want to go home," he said.
sentences.zh: 我想要到去家， 他说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: Later in the day, Gran came to the hall.
sentences.zh: 后来在……里这一天， Gran 来到这门厅。

sentences.en: "You can all stay with me until the flood goes down," she said.
sentences.zh: 你能全部停留和……一起我直到这洪水去向下， 她说。

sentences.en: The children were pleased.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是请。

sentences.en: "It will be fun staying with Gran," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 它将是乐趣停留和……一起 Gran， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Thank you Gran," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。

sentences.en: When the floods were over they went back home.
sentences.zh: 当……时这洪水是在……上方他们去回来家。

sentences.en: They gasped when they saw the house.
sentences.zh: 他们喘气当……时他们看见这房子。

sentences.en: The floors were covered in mud.
sentences.zh: 这地板是有顶棚的在……里淤泥。

sentences.en: "What a mess!" Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么一个脏乱！ 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "I hate it." "Never mind," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我憎恶它。 从不头脑， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Bad things like this happen sometimes."
sentences.zh: 坏的东西喜欢这个发生有时。

sentences.en: He gave the children a big hug.
sentences.zh: 他给这孩子们一个大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Then he gave them some mops and brooms.
sentences.zh: 然后他给他们一些拖把和扫帚。

sentences.en: "And what's more important than all this mud?
sentences.zh: 和是什么更多重要的比全部这个淤泥？

sentences.en: "We are," Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 我们是， 说妈妈。
